Description.SourceString:
Ava is the apprentice to Dr Oddenstein, an eccentric scientist who lives in Draynor Manor, and a skilled inventor in her own right. She whiles away her limited free time by studying the lesser-known field of necroballistics, and creating strange and wonderful gizmos to further her studies. 

Perhaps her proudest achievement, is the invention of the attractor. By harnessing the energies of an undead chicken to the harmonic frequencies of a common bar magnet, her device can snatch grounded projectiles and bring them back to the quiver before they can be lost. This money saving experiment is not only great for hunters, but for anyone looking for an excuse to fill their enemies full of sharp sticks of wood. 

Always the generous sort, but one with little head for marketing, Ava has decided to pass on her genius invention to others. Rather than publishing a paper, or passing the methodology onto the Varrock library, she has instead written the instructions in a bottle and sent it adrift in the ocean for anyone to find. Fate, she believes, will draw it to where it is meant to go. Like magnets, probably.
